title: Mobile shows a simplified external totals bar below the table with Totals left and the grand Subtotal right
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report with data in a viewport below 1024px.
custom_steps:
1. Find the totals bar and read it.
2. Swipe the table horizontally and watch the bar.
3. Scroll the page vertically and watch the bar.
custom_expected:
1. A simplified external totals bar sits directly below the table, outside its horizontal scroll container, showing "Totals" on the left and the grand Subtotal on the right (no other metrics).
2. It does not scroll horizontally — it is always fully visible across.
3. During vertical page scroll it sits after the table in normal flow (not pinned to the viewport bottom).
4. It uses the white card surface with a thin top border.
